description: One rejected discovery item of a `SynchronizationRequest`, keyed by the plugin-owned identity of the rejected item: `pluginRouteId` for a route or group route, or `relationshipExternalId` for a relationship. Exactly one of the two is set. It shares the `code`, `family`, `status` and `message` fields of `BatchItemError`; discovery items are keyed by plugin-owned identity because they carry no `requestId`. A request with any rejected item is rejected as a whole and lists every rejected item.

pluginRouteId.description: Plugin-owned identifier of the rejected route or group route. Set unless the item is a relationship.

relationshipExternalId.description: Plugin-owned `externalId` of the rejected relationship. Set only for relationship items.

interface.description: Canonical capability interface name the failure applies to, when the failure is interface-specific.

version.description: Declared capability interface version the failure applies to, when the failure is interface-specific.

status.description: HTTP-equivalent status code of the item failure.

message.description: Plain-language description of the failure and the suggested fix.
